semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in testing and certification for semiconductor equipment, which is critical for ensuring compliance and performance in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shanghai Safeslab Technology Co., Ltd, through its representative office Xinxiang Technology, provides professional SEMI S2 and F47 testing and certification services for semiconductor and industrial equipment. The company is focused on delivering global certification, conformity testing, and technical consulting services to manufacturers in various sectors, including semiconductor equipment.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a representative office in China, focusing on local and international manufacturers.
